summary.text: Configures the specified compute resource when it is published as an Azure sandbox container.

remarks.text: When the application model contains a single compute environment, Aspire assigns the resource to that environment automatically. When multiple compute environments exist, call
WithComputeEnvironment

summary.text: Configures the user-assigned managed identity that Azure Dev Compute uses to pull sandbox images from the configured Azure Container Registry.

remarks.text: The supplied identity must be attached to an existing sandbox group and have the
AcrPull
role on its registry. For sandbox groups created by Aspire, the identity is attached automatically, but the caller remains responsible for granting
AcrPull

summary.text: Clears the managed identities explicitly configured for sandbox workloads.

remarks.text: Workload identities requested by individual compute resources are added to the sandbox group during deployment preparation. Image pulls require a separate user-assigned identity. Aspire creates one by default for new groups; callers can select one with
WithAcrPullIdentity
and must do so for existing groups.

summary.text: Configures a system-assigned managed identity for sandbox workloads.

remarks.text: Image pulls require a separate user-assigned identity. Aspire creates one by default for new groups; callers can select one with
WithAcrPullIdentity
and must do so for existing groups. Workload identities requested by individual compute resources may add more user-assigned identities.
